responsibility: This header supplies concrete per-core cost model tables for the AArch64 backend, describing relative costs of ALU operations, multiplies and divides, loads and stores, scalar floating-point operations, and vector operations for specific microarchitectures. These cpu_cost_table objects are consumed by the main backend cost code to drive instruction costing, combine decisions, address-cost heuristics, and vectorization profitability in a way that distinguishes cores such as ThunderX, QDF24xx, and Ampere variants.
